bytes_basis: one steady denoising pass (1081 launches, last generation), Nsight Compute L2 read misses + L2 write sectors to system memory (32 B sectors; writes are an upper bound)
scope: Kernel replay, no cache flush, clocks not locked; memcpy and CPU work excluded. One ncu run per counter, merged per launch; durations from the first run.
limitations: Counted FP16 Tensor Core ops only (FP32 instruction counters not collected); INT4/INT8 Tensor Core, scalar FP16/BF16 and SFU work are not counted.
